environment.description: Terraform provider binary runs as 'terraform' user on a shared CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04). Multiple pipeline jobs share the same filesystem namespace. No MAC framework is loaded (AppArmor is in complain-only mode via `aa-complain`). The /tmp directory is a shared tmpfs mount accessible by all users. Other CI jobs run concurrently under different UIDs with read access to /tmp/terraform-cert-deploy/.
